name: Stoic Exemplar
text: Whenever a melee attack targets the bearer's unit (an attached unit included), and an enemy unit has finished a Charge move this turn within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit, that attack suffers -1 to its wound roll. Once the condition holds it applies to every melee attacker, including ones that did not charge.

effect.name: Stoic Exemplar
effect.text: Melee attacks against the bearer's unit suffer -1 to the wound roll once an enemy unit has ended a Charge move in Engagement Range of it this turn.

name: Zealous Wrath
text: Advance rolls and Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit (an attached unit included) may be re-rolled.

effect.name: Zealous Wrath
effect.text: The bearer's unit may re-roll its Advance rolls.

effect.name: Zealous Wrath
effect.text: The bearer's unit may re-roll its Charge rolls.

name: Determined Combatant
text: While the bearer is within range of an objective marker, every weapon the bearer carries, ranged and melee, has [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

effect.name: Determined Combatant
effect.text: While the bearer is within range of an objective marker, its weapons have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

name: Wages of Retribution
text: Each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES model from your army destroys your Oath of Moment target while the bearer is on the battlefield, roll one D6: on a 4+ you gain 1 CP.

effect.name: Wages of Retribution
